name: manual_d2e07c
claim: A byte-identity check between two repositories pins every shared file against the counterpart's pinned copy, so an edit to a shared file cannot pass until both sides move together; add new scenarios as a new file in both repositories and guard drift with a SHA-256 literal in each repository's own test.

decisions.notes: Extending the shared C2 probe would have failed cmp against the older copy in the pinned counterpart and forced a circular pin sequence; a new file with a hash literal needs one pull request per repository.

rationale: Extending the shared C2 probe would have failed cmp against the older copy in the pinned counterpart and forced a circular pin sequence; a new file with a hash literal needs one pull request per repository.
